name: Composition Subdomain
body:
Associated Domain: Art

Replacement Power: The following granted power replaces the enthralling art power of the Art domain.

Multi-Sensory Experience (Su)

At 8th level, any spell you cast that has a triggering symbol, words, sigils or runes may have the following additional triggering actions.

Auditory: A creature can hear the spell which can be a song or a tone at the caster’s discretion. An auditory trigger can be heard outside of half of its effect radius with a DC 15 plus the spell level Perception check. If the creature passes into half the spell’s effect radius, the tone or song becomes obvious and if the creature can hear it, the spell is triggered if so chosen. For example, a symbol of death would have an auditory trigger with a 30 foot radius (half of the 60 foot effect radius). More elaborate triggering events may be selected on the number of creatures to hear the sigil, etc. as normal.
Olfactory: As auditory above, but the spell emits a smell instead of tones.

Replacement Domain Spells: 1st-crafter’s fortune, 4th–minor creation, 5th–major creation, 9th–scribe’s binding
